decisions.reason: Because ACT remained on the website into 2024 and fits the firm's semiconductor-packaging niche, management would likely keep it while monitoring whether its still-vague market traction rises above aspiration levels rather than reallocating resources immediately.

Because VLIS was only launched in 2024 with a dedicated page and clear strategic positioning in advanced semiconductor applications, management would likely give it more time under uncertainty and keep it unless early feedback falls clearly below aspirations.
